references.text: Earlier in the chapter, it is described how the Israelites took the Midianite women, children, and all their livestock as plunder.
Describes how all the plunder and spoils were brought to Moses and Eleazar the priest on the plains of Moab.
Shows how half of the plunder was distributed among the warriors, including the number of sheep.
Legislation regarding war booty that allowed the Israelites to take livestock and everything else in the city as plunder.
A similar situation where Israel took livestock and spoils from Ai as war booty according to the Lord's command.
Joshua sends the tribes home with great plunder, including livestock, after defeating their enemies.
